# Support & Getting Help

Thank you for exploring the **Bijective Base-6 Calculator & Explorer**!

## How to Get Help

- **Documentation & Study Guide**: Check the [Study tab on base6.art](https://base6.art/?tab=study) or review the [README.md](../README.md) for full algorithmic explanations and manual calculation walk-throughs.
- **Bug Reports**: If you encounter an unexpected calculation result or interface issue, please [open a Bug Report](https://github.com/tripping-alien/bijective_base6_calc/issues/new?template=bug_report.md).
- **Feature Requests**: Want to suggest additional lookup tables, new problem modes, or visualizations? [Submit a Feature Request](https://github.com/tripping-alien/bijective_base6_calc/issues/new?template=feature_request.md).
- **Translations**: Want to contribute or polish a language translation? Check out the guide in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
